name: @pacifica-dev/mcp

tools.name: pacifica-markets
tools.description:
List all available perpetual markets on Pacifica, or look up a single market by symbol.

Returns symbol, tick_size, max_leverage, lot_size, and more.

Free — no auth required.

symbol.description: Filter to a single market (e.g. BTC)

tools.name: pacifica-prices
tools.description:
Get real-time prices for all Pacifica markets, or filter by symbol.

Returns mark, oracle, mid, funding rate, next_funding, open_interest, volume_24h.

Free — no auth required.

symbol.description: Filter to a single symbol (e.g. BTC)

tools.name: pacifica-orderbook
tools.description:
Get the order book (bids and asks) for a Pacifica market.

Free — no auth required.

tools.name: pacifica-candles
tools.description:
Get OHLCV candlestick data for a Pacifica market.

Free — no auth required.

tools.name: pacifica-mark-candles
tools.description:
Get OHLCV candlestick data based on the mark price for a Pacifica market.

Similar to pacifica-candles but uses the mark price instead of trade price.

Free — no auth required.

tools.name: pacifica-recent-trades
tools.description:
Get recent trades for a Pacifica market.

Returns price, amount, side, and cause for each trade.

Free — no auth required.

tools.name: pacifica-funding-rates
tools.description:
Get historical funding rates for a Pacifica market.

Free — no auth required.

tools.name: pacifica-account
tools.description:
Get account overview: balance, equity, margin used, positions count, fee level.

If no account address is provided, uses the local MCP wallet.

Free — no auth required.

account.description: Solana wallet address to query. Defaults to MCP wallet.

tools.name: pacifica-account-settings
tools.description:
Get account settings including margin settings and leverage per market.

If no account address is provided, uses the local MCP wallet.

Free — no auth required.

account.description: Solana wallet address to query. Defaults to MCP wallet.

tools.name: pacifica-positions
tools.description:
Get all open positions for an account.

Returns symbol, side, amount, entry_price, margin, funding for each position.

If no account address is provided, uses the local MCP wallet.

Free — no auth required.

account.description: Solana wallet address to query. Defaults to MCP wallet.

tools.name: pacifica-trade-history
tools.description:
Get historical trades for an account, with PnL and fees.

If no account address is provided, uses the local MCP wallet.

Free — no auth required.

account.description: Solana wallet address to query. Defaults to MCP wallet.

tools.name: pacifica-portfolio
tools.description:
Get portfolio equity history over time.

If no account address is provided, uses the local MCP wallet.

Free — no auth required.

account.description: Solana wallet address to query. Defaults to MCP wallet.

tools.name: pacifica-balance-history
tools.description:
Get balance event history: deposits, withdrawals, trades, funding payments.

If no account address is provided, uses the local MCP wallet.

Free — no auth required.

account.description: Solana wallet address to query. Defaults to MCP wallet.

limit.description: Number of balance events to return (default 50)

tools.name: pacifica-orders
tools.description:
Get all open orders for an account.

If no account address is provided, uses the local MCP wallet.

Free — no auth required.

account.description: Solana wallet address to query. Defaults to MCP wallet.

tools.name: pacifica-order-history
tools.description:
Get historical orders for an account.

If no account address is provided, uses the local MCP wallet.

Free — no auth required.

account.description: Solana wallet address to query. Defaults to MCP wallet.

limit.description: Number of historical orders to return (default 50)

tools.name: pacifica-order-by-id
tools.description:
Get the full event history for a specific order by its order_id.

Returns all state changes (created, filled, cancelled, etc.) for the order.

Free — no auth required.

order_id.description: The order ID to look up

tools.name: pacifica-market-order
tools.description:
Place a market order on Pacifica.

bid = buy/long, ask = sell/short.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

side.description: Order side: bid = buy/long, ask = sell/short

amount.description: Order size as a decimal string

tools.name: pacifica-limit-order
tools.description:
Place a limit order on Pacifica.

bid = buy/long, ask = sell/short.
TIF options: GTC (good-til-cancel), IOC (immediate-or-cancel), ALO (add-liquidity-only), TOB (top-of-book).

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

side.description: Order side: bid = buy/long, ask = sell/short

amount.description: Order size as a decimal string

price.description: Limit price as a decimal string

tools.name: pacifica-stop-order
tools.description:
Place a stop order on Pacifica.

Triggers a market (or limit) order when the stop_price is reached.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

side.description: Order side: bid = buy/long, ask = sell/short

stop_price.description: Trigger price as a decimal string

amount.description: Order size as a decimal string

limit_price.description: Limit price after trigger. Omit for stop-market order.

tools.name: pacifica-edit-order
tools.description:
Edit an existing order's price and/or amount.

Identify the order by order_id or client_order_id.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

price.description: New limit price as a decimal string

amount.description: New order size as a decimal string

order_id.description: Order ID to edit. Provide this or client_order_id.

client_order_id.description: Client order ID to edit. Provide this or order_id.

tools.name: pacifica-batch-order
tools.description:
Submit a batch of up to 10 order actions (create and/or cancel) in a single request.

Each action is individually signed.

Requires wallet — signs each action with your Ed25519 keypair.

client_order_id.description: Client order ID to cancel (for Cancel)

tools.name: pacifica-set-tpsl
tools.description:
Set take-profit and/or stop-loss prices on an existing position.

Provide at least one of take_profit_price or stop_loss_price.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

side.description: Exit side: use ask to close a long, bid to close a short

take_profit_price.description: Take-profit trigger price as a decimal string

stop_loss_price.description: Stop-loss trigger price as a decimal string

tools.name: pacifica-cancel-order
tools.description:
Cancel a specific order by ID, or cancel ALL open orders.

If order_id is provided, cancels that single order.
If order_id is omitted, cancels all open orders (set all_symbols and exclude_reduce_only).

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

symbol.description: Market symbol (e.g. BTC). Required for single cancel. Optional filter for cancel-all when all_symbols is false.

order_id.description: Specific order ID to cancel. Omit to cancel all open orders.

all_symbols.description: Cancel orders across all symbols (default true). Only used for cancel-all.

exclude_reduce_only.description: Exclude reduce-only orders from cancellation (default false). Only used for cancel-all.

tools.name: pacifica-cancel-stop
tools.description:
Cancel a specific stop order by ID.

Identify the order by order_id or client_order_id.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

order_id.description: Stop order ID to cancel. Provide this or client_order_id.

client_order_id.description: Client order ID of the stop order. Provide this or order_id.

tools.name: pacifica-set-leverage
tools.description:
Set the leverage for a Pacifica market.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

tools.name: pacifica-set-margin-mode
tools.description:
Switch between cross margin and isolated margin for a market.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

is_isolated.description: true = isolated margin, false = cross margin

tools.name: pacifica-withdraw
tools.description:
Withdraw USDC from your Pacifica account back to your Solana wallet.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

amount.description: Amount of USDC to withdraw as a decimal string

tools.name: pacifica-create-subaccount
tools.description:
Create a new subaccount under your main Pacifica account.

Generates a fresh Ed25519 keypair for the subaccount.
Both the main account and subaccount must sign the request (dual signature).

Requires wallet — signs with your Ed25519 keypair.

tools.name: pacifica-list-subaccounts
tools.description:
List all subaccounts under your main Pacifica account.

Returns address, balance, fee level, and creation date for each subaccount.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

tools.name: pacifica-transfer-funds
tools.description:
Transfer USDC between your main account and a subaccount.

Requires wallet — signs the request with your Ed25519 keypair.

to_account.description: Destination account address (subaccount or main account)

amount.description: Amount of USDC to transfer as a decimal string

tools.name: pacifica-watch
tools.description:
Subscribe to a real-time WebSocket channel, collect events for a duration, then return them.

Channels: prices, trades, orderbook, account_info, account_positions, account_trades.

No auth required for market channels. Account channels use your wallet.

symbol.description: Market symbol (e.g. BTC) — required for trades, orderbook

account.description: Wallet address — required for account_* channels, defaults to local wallet

tools.name: pacifica-watch-start
tools.description:
Start a persistent WebSocket subscription. Events are buffered until you read them with pacifica-watch-read.

Channels: prices, trades, orderbook, account_info, account_positions, account_trades.

Use pacifica-watch-read to retrieve buffered events, pacifica-watch-stop to end.

symbol.description: Market symbol (e.g. BTC) — required for trades, orderbook

account.description: Wallet address — required for account_* channels, defaults to local wallet

tools.name: pacifica-watch-read
tools.description:
Read and drain buffered events from a persistent WebSocket subscription.

Use summary_only=true to get aggregated metrics without raw events (recommended for prices channel to avoid data flooding).

Clears the buffer after reading.

If the subscription is not found, returns active subscriptions so you can pick the right one.

summary_only.description: If true, return only the summary without raw events. Recommended for prices channel.

max_events.description: Maximum number of raw events to return (default 100). Ignored when summary_only is true.

tools.name: pacifica-watch-stop
tools.description:
Stop a WebSocket subscription (or all subscriptions if no ID is given).

Returns the list of stopped subscription IDs and any remaining active ones.

subscription_id.description: Subscription ID to stop. Omit to stop ALL subscriptions.

tools.name: pacifica-wallet
tools.description:
Show your Pacifica MCP wallet address, network, and balance.

No parameters required.

tools.name: pacifica-tools
tools.description:
List all available Pacifica MCP tools grouped by category.

No parameters required.
